name: Employer Nomination Scheme (Subclass 186) – Direct Entry stream
secondInstallmentTrigger: Family member 18+ applying with main applicant who cannot show Functional English
processingTime: Varies significantly by lodgement date and occupation category under Ministerial Direction No. 119 — use official processing time guide tool for current estimate, do not hardcode a number
ageExemptions: Nominated as academic (Level B/C/D/E) by an Australian university
Nominated as scientist/researcher/technical specialist at ANZSCO skill level 1 or 2 by a Federal/State/Territory government science agency or Australian university
Holds subclass 444 or 461 visa and has worked for nominating employer in nominated position for 2 of last 3 years (excl. unpaid leave)
workExperience: At least 3 years relevant work experience in nominated occupation, unless exempt
workExperienceExemption: Exempt if exempt from skills assessment requirement
occupationList: Core Skills Occupation List (CSOL), benchmarked to 2022 ANZSCO

skillsAssessment.notes: Cannot have been issued more than 3 years before application date. Skills assessments obtained for a subclass 485 visa are NOT accepted.

skillsAssessmentExemptions: Nominated as academic (Level A/B/C/D/E) by an Australian university
Nominated as scientist/researcher/technical specialist by an Australian government scientific agency
Holds subclass 444 or 461 visa and worked for nominating employer in nominated position for 2 of last 3 years
englishRequirement: Competent English (main applicant); Functional English for dependants 18+, else second instalment applies
salaryRequirement: Nominated salary must meet or exceed the Core Skills Income Threshold (CSIT) of AUD 79,423 (effective 1 July 2026), unless exempt by a specific labour agreement
employerObligation: Must begin employment within 6 months of visa grant (if granted onshore) or entry to Australia (if granted offshore); expected to work for nominating employer at least 2 years
nominationRequirement: Must apply for visa within 6 months of nomination approval; does not need to wait for nomination approval to lodge visa application, only needs the nomination Transaction Reference Number (TRN)
travelFacility: 5 years from grant date; Resident Return visa (RRV) required after that to re-enter as permanent resident
description: Permits skilled workers nominated by an Australian employer to live and work in Australia permanently. Requires a positive skills assessment (unless exempt), 3 years relevant experience (unless exempt), an occupation on the CSOL, and competent English.
requirements: Under 45 years old at application date, unless exempt
Nominated for an occupation on the Core Skills Occupation List
At least 3 years relevant work experience, unless exempt
Positive skills assessment before lodging, unless exempt
Competent English
Meet health and character requirements
Nominated by an actively and lawfully operating Australian employer
Hold mandatory state/territory licensing/registration/membership if applicable
steps: Get skills assessment (if required, valid ≤3 years, not from a 485 assessment)
Sit English test if required (valid ≤3 years)
Employer lodges nomination application and receives Transaction Reference Number (TRN)
Lodge visa application in ImmiAccount with TRN (no need to wait for nomination approval)
Attach identity, skills, English, health, character documents
Pay visa application charge (application not processed until paid)
Respond to any request for biometrics or additional information
Wait for nomination approval (visa cannot be granted before this) and visa decision

name: Employer Nomination Scheme (Subclass 186) – Labour Agreement stream
secondInstallmentTrigger: Family member 18+ applying with main applicant who cannot show Functional English
processingTime: Use official processing time guide tool for current estimate, do not hardcode a number
ageExemptions: Unless the labour agreement itself provides a different age limit
workExperience: Set by the specific labour agreement, not a fixed department-wide rule
occupationListNote: Occupation eligibility is defined by the specific labour agreement, not the CSOL

skillsAssessment.notes: Department may ask for a skills assessment on a case-by-case basis. IMPORTANT: do not obtain one unless specifically requested.

englishRequirement: As specified in the labour agreement (varies by agreement); Functional English for dependants 18+, else second instalment applies
salaryRequirement: As specified in the labour agreement; may differ from the standard CSIT threshold
employerObligation: Must begin employment within 6 months of visa grant (if granted onshore) or entry to Australia (if granted offshore); expected to work for nominating employer at least 2 years
priorVisaRequirement: If applying while in Australia, must hold a substantive subclass 457 or 482 visa issued under a labour agreement
nominationRequirement: Employer must be party to a labour agreement and lodge nomination; applicant needs the nomination Transaction Reference Number (TRN)
travelFacility: 5 years from grant date; Resident Return visa (RRV) required after that to re-enter as permanent resident
description: Permits skilled workers currently working, or preparing to work, for an employer under a labour agreement to live and work in Australia permanently. Eligibility criteria (age, skills, English) are set by the specific labour agreement rather than standard department thresholds.
requirements: Currently work, or be preparing to work, for a nominating employer party to a labour agreement
Meet the age, skills, and English language requirements set by that specific labour agreement
If onshore, hold a substantive 457 or 482 visa issued under a labour agreement
Meet health and character requirements
Hold mandatory state/territory licensing/registration/membership if applicable
steps: Confirm current or prospective employer is party to a labour agreement
Employer lodges nomination application and receives Transaction Reference Number (TRN)
Only get a skills assessment if the department specifically requests one
Lodge visa application in ImmiAccount with TRN
Attach identity, health, character documents (skills/English evidenced per labour agreement terms)
Pay visa application charge (application not processed until paid)
Respond to any request for biometrics or additional information
Wait for nomination approval (visa cannot be granted before this) and visa decision

name: Employer Nomination Scheme (Subclass 186) – Temporary Residence Transition stream
secondInstallmentTrigger: Family member 18+ applying with main applicant who cannot show Functional English
processingTime: Varies significantly by lodgement date and occupation category under Ministerial Direction No. 119 — use official processing time guide tool for current estimate, do not hardcode a number
ageExemptions: Has worked for the nominating employer for at least 3 years in the 3 years before applying (announced Dec 2024, effective 1 July 2025)
Nominated as academic (Level B/C/D/E) by an Australian university
Nominated as scientist/researcher/technical specialist at ANZSCO skill level 1 or 2 by a Federal/State/Territory government science agency or Australian university
workExperience: At least 2 years employed in the nominated occupation while the employer held approved-sponsor status, aggregated across employers if more than one (DHA removed the same-employer requirement in Dec 2024)
occupationList: Core Skills Occupation List (CSOL), benchmarked to 2022 ANZSCO

skillsAssessment.notes: A skills assessment is generally not required for the TRT stream. The department may ask for one on a case-by-case basis — do not obtain one unless specifically requested.

englishRequirement: Competent English (main applicant); Functional English for dependants 18+, else second instalment applies
salaryRequirement: Nominated salary must meet or exceed the Core Skills Income Threshold (CSIT) of AUD 79,423 (effective 1 July 2026), unless exempt by a specific labour agreement
employerObligation: Must begin employment within 6 months of visa grant (if granted onshore) or entry to Australia (if granted offshore); expected to work for nominating employer at least 2 years
priorVisaRequirement: Must have held a subclass 457 or 482 visa and worked in the nominated occupation under an approved sponsor for at least 2 of the 3 years before applying (periods under different approved sponsors can be aggregated)
nominationRequirement: Must apply for visa within 6 months of nomination approval; does not need to wait for nomination approval to lodge visa application, only needs the nomination Transaction Reference Number (TRN)
travelFacility: 5 years from grant date; Resident Return visa (RRV) required after that to re-enter as permanent resident
description: Permits skilled workers who have been working for an approved sponsor under a temporary skilled visa to transition to permanent residence. Requires at least 2 years of employment in the nominated occupation under approved-sponsor status (aggregated across employers), and does not require a skills assessment.
requirements: Under 45 years old at application date, unless exempt
Have held a subclass 457 or 482 visa and worked in the nominated occupation for at least 2 years under an approved sponsor (aggregated across employers)
Nominated for an occupation on the Core Skills Occupation List
Competent English
Meet health and character requirements
Nominated by an actively and lawfully operating Australian employer
Hold mandatory state/territory licensing/registration/membership if applicable
steps: Confirm employment history under approved sponsor(s) in the nominated occupation totals at least 2 years
Sit English test if required (valid ≤3 years)
Employer lodges nomination application and receives Transaction Reference Number (TRN)
Lodge visa application in ImmiAccount with TRN (no need to wait for nomination approval)
Attach identity, English, health, character documents
Pay visa application charge (application not processed until paid)
Respond to any request for biometrics or additional information
Wait for nomination approval (visa cannot be granted before this) and visa decision
